summary: Genasys Inc. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, reporting entry into and closing of a First Amendment to a Loan Agreement with Maran Partners Fund, LP. The amendment extends maturity of the existing $4,300,000 unsecured term loan from September 14, 2026 to October 30, 2026, following an $800,000 repayment leaving $3,500,000 outstanding. Advance notice for optional prepayments drops from 30 days to 3 business days, and an amendment fee of $92,500 was paid at closing. This is a routine credit-facility modification, not a special situation, though the short extension and mandatory change-of-control prepayment provisions merit monitoring.
